text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen wins the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). She ran with all her might to 
bring the glorious shield back home to the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Palmer had run for her 
own freedom... Yet she began to wonder: 
was this truly something to be proud of? 
Or was it just pure selfishness?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the spring Grand Prix, 
the Takarazuka Kinen. In a festival-like 
race that fires up fans and runners alike, 
can Mejiro Palmer rediscover her true 
self?
